column1: # BMX XXX's (SLUS-20415) library functions with no C++ here and no runtime replacement, on purpose (libraries are never
# rewritten; sce/not_ported.tsv is AI's). Every function of functions.tsv's sdk layer is readable (a shared body at
# level 2, or this folder's), the runtime's (runtime_replaced.py: a stub or a kernel call wrapper, nothing of the
# game's left), or a row here. Sony's release 2.4, AI's (plus libscf) has no source on disk; newlib's and libgcc's rows (memcmp, _sbrk_r, __moddi3) are only called by the runtime's stubs.
# A row's reason is this game's, from its call graph (direct calls and code that takes the address), its data and
# its recording corpus: "the runtime replaces its callers" when every caller is the runtime's or such a row, "dead"
# when nothing reaches it, "the recompiled original runs" otherwise. Where AI's row says the same, its words are
# kept. Columns: address, library, name, AI's counterpart (its name and the pair: identical, close, drifted, weak,
